metadata.artifact_title: DeepSeek Harness ADR-03: Unified State and Registry Architecture
metadata.language: Lean 4 architecture packet with Markdown rationale
metadata.source_title: Shi, Zhang, and Cui, A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability

decision.statement: Use a positive finite registry raw state with explicit WellFormed/ValidState views; store only data and reified codes/tokens in FiberCell; interpret behavior and recovery externally; derive the core coeffect from active local stores; do not add an implicit mutable rootStore.

global_assumptions: Ambient is an external, non-recursive, unkeyed state slice inside the chosen formal boundary.
Code/token types are declared in a layer that does not depend on RawState; closure captures are reified as data.
IncarnationId is an abstract identity type with an explicit DecidableEq for finite registry operations; freshness and reuse policy remain BD-NAMES.
The Section-4 core has no implicit root provider table; root services are ordinary root-parent fibers or a separately named extension.
External action semantics may be nondeterministic and may quantify over RawState, but no such relation/function is stored recursively in a state cell.

alternatives.reason: Gamma occurs negatively in Gamma -> Gamma; ordinary Lean strict positivity and ordinary Set fixed-point reading do not support the intended carrier.
Recreates the negative State/Registry/Fiber cycle and hides the actor/frame footprint.
Overly heavy for finite runtime registries, loses representatives needed by rules, and needs a separate executable refinement.
Imposes a compile-time nesting bound and complicates dynamic registration; a bounded fragment may be a later lemma.
Cannot expose finite registry, parent, support, provider, and frame facts needed by the calculus.
Introduces a second mutation path and an unnecessary coherence invariant.
Changes D45/T63/T66 empty-state and provider assumptions; an immutable seed needs a named provider-identity extension.
Prematurely resolves BD-ITER and BD-CONTROL and can recreate recursive semantic references.
Preserves positivity and arbitrary finite runtime hierarchy while leaving iterator, staging, control, names, and realms explicit.

state_carrier.positivity_rule: RawState and FiberCell contain no RawState-indexed function field; Ambient and all code/token parameters are lexically non-recursive.
state_carrier.trusted_api: proof-indexed or Option/Except checked transitions preserve WellFormed; malformed RawState remains representable for counterexamples and intermediate semantics

fiber_registry.payload_policy: Optional accumulator and committed view are normalized lifecycle payload slots linked to Life by LifecycleCoherent; a later lifecycle ADR may make them indexed Life constructors.
fiber_registry.registry_identity: The Finmap key is the incarnation identity; no internal self field is introduced. Freshness/generation/alpha policy is BD-NAMES.

provider_view.missing_meaning: retired or currently unsatisfied; no default provider

well_formedness.name: ParentClosed
well_formedness.requirement: Every non-root parent pointer names a registry entry.

well_formedness.name: ParentAcyclic
well_formedness.requirement: The transitive parent-edge relation has no cycle.

well_formedness.name: ParentRooted
well_formedness.requirement: The selected names/registration boundary supplies the distinguished root convention; the spike exposes the closed/acyclic forest and defers the root witness to BD-NAMES.

well_formedness.name: TableConfined
well_formedness.requirement: Support of each localStore is a subset of that cell's provisions.

well_formedness.name: ProvisionDisjoint
well_formedness.requirement: Distinct current incarnation keys have disjoint declared provision sets; vestigial retired entries remain until O-Remove.

well_formedness.name: LifecycleCoherent
well_formedness.requirement: installed implies accumulator and committed payloads; either payload implies installed; providesNow implies installed and accumulator; committedVisible implies committed and accumulator; a retired-but-still-Active fiber may continue providing until L-Leave.

well_formedness.name: CommittedProvidersClosed
well_formedness.requirement: Every provider ID named by a stored view is an installed registry entry.

well_formedness.name: DeclarationConsistency
well_formedness.requirement: If component is a catalog identifier, its catalog specification agrees with the authoritative requirements/provisions fields.

derived_views.contributes_now: policy.providesNow lifecycle = true; retirement is intentionally not included because O-Retire can precede L-Leave.
derived_views.active_coeffect: disjoint union of localStore for fibers whose contributesNow predicate holds

aggregation.production: absorbing Option Store merge with Finmap.foldl and an unconditional swap/commutativity proof
aggregation.validity: WellFormed implies no overlap and hence the fold result is some store; raw Finmap.union left bias is observationally irrelevant under disjointness

provider_notions: current active provider k present in active coeffect and contributing cell
derived_views.provider_lookup: Option IncarnationId, backed by a ProviderOf relation and a uniqueness theorem under TableConfined + ProvisionDisjoint
derived_views.committed_lookup: follow a consumer's committed ProviderView to the provider's localStore, including guarded Unloading
lifecycle_projection_cases: Active -> Unloading removes the provider contribution immediately
Reloading -> Active adds the local table
guarded Unload applies the accumulator after provider withdrawal
derived_views.root_extension: seededCoeffect seed state = seed ∪ activeUnion state is store-observation-only unless an extension introduces ProviderId = root | fiber id and re-proves provider/guard laws

frame_obligations: modifyFiber n changes only the cell at n
lookup at m ≠ n is unchanged
removeFiber n leaves every other entry unchanged
local-table updates affect active coeffect only through n's contribution
actor actions may change Ambient only within an explicit read/write slice
operations_and_frames.factorization: A deterministic step is an external ControlEdit ∘ StateMap; nondeterministic rules carry labelled witnesses rather than storing functions in state.

action_code_boundary.semantics_shape: forward : IncarnationId → BehaviorCode → RawState → RawState → AccumulatorCode → Prop; inverse : IncarnationId → AccumulatorCode → RawState → RawState → Prop
action_code_boundary.nondeterminism: allowed by relation-valued semantics; iterator/failure/control result payloads are deferred
required_laws: explicit code-denotation/equivalence bridge when a semantic observation compares behavior tokens

observation_boundary.CoreStateObs: StoreObs R (activeUnion policy s) (activeUnion policy t)
observation_boundary.EraseControl: separately named Section-4 recovery relation; not silently identified with LifecycleObs
observation_boundary.ambient_policy: CoreStateObs forgets Ambient; use a stronger AmbientObs when ambient state is observed
observation_boundary.adr01_adr02_bridge: Use ADR-01 explicit relation values and ADR-02 StoreObs/Option definedness; code-token denotation relations are explicit obligations.

paper_repair_manifest.D32: Replace literal negative μΓ by TrackedContext plus finite parent registry and external accumulator/action semantics; prove a representation/refinement theorem rather than definitional equality.
paper_repair_manifest.D33: Lift ADR-02 store observation through active coeffect projection.
paper_repair_manifest.D43: Finite requirements/provisions and behavior codes with explicit frame predicates.
paper_repair_manifest.D44: Lifecycle-parameterized FiberCell with per-incarnation behavior and optional accumulator/committed payload slots.
paper_repair_manifest.D45: Finite registry, parent invariants, active-table union, Option provider lookup, and uniqueness obligations.
paper_repair_manifest.D46: Option ProviderView; target eligibility depends on retirement and satisfaction, not current installed phase; the spike's targetView is a classical-choice semantic representative.
paper_repair_manifest.D47: Registration/retirement are external control edits with identity witnesses; freshness remains BD-NAMES.
paper_repair_manifest.D48: Actor-indexed external relation plus explicit write/read frame obligations.
paper_repair_manifest.D49: Separate installed, providesNow, and committed visibility; concrete phases await later ADRs.
paper_repair_manifest.D50: Relied-upon relation over finite installed registry and committed provider views.
paper_repair_manifest.D53: Split traces, episodes, state-map/control-edit witnesses, and observation relations over one raw carrier.
paper_repair_manifest.L55: State carrier is available; successor invariance still needs control and relation-respect decisions.
paper_repair_manifest.D58: WellFormed exposes parent/support/disjointness/view closure; root/freshness policy remains BD-NAMES.
paper_repair_manifest.R.full: One state carrier and labelled external relations; full ten-rule semantics awaits ITER/STAGING/CONTROL/NAMES.

affected_disposition_nodes.readiness_rule: Start from immutable Harness-04 blocker sets and remove only BD-STATE; preserve all other blockers and dependency edges.

coding_rules: Use ADR-02 Store/Finmap APIs; do not introduce a second downstream store carrier.
Keep Ambient and all code/token parameters lexically non-recursive.
Pass IncarnationId to action semantics; do not identify fibers solely by component code.
Keep RawState and ValidState distinct; checked failures have no fabricated successor proof.
Derive core coeffect from active local stores; no cached mutable global store.
Use Option for absent providers/targets; defaults are not providers.
Prove active-union order independence explicitly; left-biased notation is not a proof.
Keep declared provision, local support, active presence, installed status, and committed visibility distinct.
Use CoreStateObs, LifecycleObs, and EraseControl as separate named relations.
Keep StateMap/ControlEdit as external witnesses, never recursive state fields.
Do not make hidden final choices for BD-NAMES, BD-ITER, BD-STAGING, BD-CONTROL, or BD-SCOPED.

Option target/committed views with finite domain proof and provider-closure boundary
persistent registry update and frame laws
CoreStateObs lift through ADR-01/ADR-02 observation APIs
external actor-indexed action relation and WellFormed-preservation premise
affected-node set and blocker subtraction match Harness-04

repair_record.root_cause: Implicit generalization left the Fiber parameters unresolved at the Registry definition, causing instance search to see DecidableEq ?m.
changes: Explicitly specialize Fiber, Registry, RawState, TrackedContext, and ActionSemantics parameters.
Add local notation for specialized carriers.
Make Bool branching, state annotations, lookup cases, and unused parameters explicit where required by elaboration.
Generalize StateMap and ControlEdit as ordinary State -> State constructors and specialize call sites.
reported_non_changes: active coeffect and retirement timing semantics
repair_record.api_compatibility_note: Former bare aliases are no longer accepted; downstream callers must provide the carrier parameters. This is a surface API correction, not a new state architecture.

known_followups: Consider moving DecidableEq Key requirements from carrier declarations to operations/theorems.
Add ParentRooted and catalog DeclarationConsistency at the appropriate boundary.
State a lifecycle-policy soundness law connecting providesNow to the selected Active phase.
Prove WF-relative adequacy/specification lemmas for classical-choice providerOf and targetView.
Add committed-table support/freeze invariants and checked static-field-preserving updates.
Prove actor frame/confinement laws and executable traversal-order-independent aggregation.
non_decisions: BD-CONTROL asynchronous scheduler, failure labels, and full lifecycle relation
deterministic evaluator versus finite-result-list versus relation implementation for action codes
runtime mutable object identity, proxies, host resources, and disposer closure implementation
mutable or overlapping root store in the Section-4 core

revision.promotion_rule: after a user-reported pinned compilation of a candidate revision, promote that revision to compiler-validated status and record the toolchain; if source repair was required, retain the prior source as historical
reopen_triggers: positive shell fails strict positivity or requires unsafe casts
registry cannot state D45/D48/D53/T63 parent/frame/provider invariants
active projection cannot be made traversal-order independent under explicit disjointness
later theorem requires an actually infinite reachable registry/coeffect support
faithful core requires an implicit mutable root store or duplicate global cache
action codes necessarily embed unresolved iterator/control choices
committed lookup cannot preserve guarded Unloading visibility
scoped extension lacks a lookup/update-faithful flat embedding
runtime refinement makes closure identity or untracked effects part of the core observation
revision.workflow_rule: derive readiness from immutable baselines plus accepted/superseding ADRs and explicitly recorded blockers; never rewrite Harness-03/04 in place
